config.week_definition: Monday through Sunday; map source holiday Tuesday/Wednesday starts into that week's Monday
config.primary_fixed_change: SKEW weekly close minus weekly open <= -5 points
config.normalized_change: current open-to-close change minus mean of previous 104 calendar-week changes, divided by their sample standard deviation (ddof=1); all 104 must exist; current week excluded
config.entry: first observed ES open in the following Monday-Sunday week
config.exit: last observed ES close in the h-th following week; every forward week must exist and be completed
config.normalization_history_audit: Also disclose previous 104 actually reported observations (can cross absent weeks), because the source's treatment of gaps was unspecified; do not select based on outcome
